findings.note: Question (new this round): the round-4 absence semantics makes preDelete removal while deletion is in progress an immediate, one-way barrier release (finalizer removed, deletion proceeds without executor release), and it cannot be re-established (no finalizer re-add after deletionTimestamp). Accidental config removal (GitOps revert, partial apply) now force-completes deletion where round 3 explicitly called this an unsupported hook-skip. Ask for either an admission guard for preDelete removal during deletion, or an explicit risk acknowledgment + operator guidance; also reconcile the enablement asymmetry (enablement during deletion is rejected, removal proceeds).
